name: SDF Training with Eikonal Loss
aliases: SDF Surface Training with Eikonal Loss
Neural SDF Training with Eikonal Regularization
Implicit neural representations with Eikonal regularization
definition: Trains a signed distance function (SDF) network using point cloud data and Eikonal regularization to enforce unit gradient magnitude.
summary: SDF Training with Eikonal Loss reconstructs high-fidelity 3D shapes by enforcing the Eikonal equation to ensure valid metric distance fields, unlike methods lacking global geometric regularization.
